apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(home): fade the hero into the background and show the first episode on the play button (`4266e205`)
- fix(player): fall back to the first preferred subtitle instead of using the secondary preference as a second track (`e16554c9`)
- fix(mobile): move log out into the account profile card (`57f7abb7`)
- fix(android): satisfy lint for back handling, the pip receiver and file open filters, and add the x86_64 Rust target to CI (`95590797`)
- fix(core): apply rustfmt and clippy fixes and drop the benches for removed stream badge methods (`dadc397d`)
- fix(i18n): add the missing Arabic and Hebrew TV and ticket strings (`ada66d16`)
- fix(updater): detect Windows setup installs in system_package (`8849853f`)
- feat(updater): add rollback, resumable downloads, key rotation and a mandatory floor (`48c74e7b`)
- feat(windows): ship only a per-user setup installer (`2a08dfad`)
- fix(effects): put bundled_roots on the client builder in downloads and tmdb (`abeb8cb6`)
- fix(effects): honor SSL_CERT_FILE alongside the bundled roots (`650148a1`)
- fix(android): verify TLS with bundled roots so requests stop hanging on the splash screen (`11b52770`)
- feat(sync): sync settings and provider credentials with the Nuvio account (`5ceacc11`)
- fix(core): keep the ffi method table sorted for the Nuvio settings routes (`cfdea931`)
- fix(deps): drop unused rquickjs dyn-load so dlopen2 stops breaking Android builds (`6ee6f5aa`)
- feat(core): plan Nuvio settings blob and provide
